page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.14xlarge is a general-purpose instance type belonging to the ecs.sn2ne family. It is powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor with an x86_64 architecture, operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance features 56 dedicated physical cores and 56 vCPUs, with 1.0 thread per core. It is configured with 224.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced memory-to-vCPU ratio of 4.0 GB per core. The instance does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, and it utilizes the KVM hypervisor. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 10 Gbps.

Benchmark data reveals a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core performance is relatively weak, as shown by stress-ng single-core and Geekbench single-core scores falling into the bottom 25 percent, alongside a poor rating for single-threaded gzip compression. However, the high core count compensates for this limitation, yielding average multi-core performance across stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression benchmarks. Memory bandwidth for both small and large blocks remains in the average tier.

This hardware profile is suited for workloads that can leverage parallel processing to offset the modest single-core speeds. Appropriate workloads include multi-threaded database operations, static web serving, and software compilation, all of which achieved average performance tiers in Passmark and Geekbench tests. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the instance offers a high density of dedicated physical cores and balanced memory allocation, making it a viable option for legacy enterprise applications and parallelized general-purpose workloads that do not require local NVMe storage.
